note: Applicability and evidence states are fixture annotations, never Noul outputs or runtime text classifiers. J2 evaluates purpose for one candidate claimed line; it does not compute or exclude invoice amounts.

cases.invoice_item_description: Cab passenger trip from home to the regular office
cases.employee_justification: My ordinary daily commute to the office.
cases.reason: Explicit normal commuting, not an exceptional business requirement.

cases.invoice_item_description: Cab passenger trip from home to the regular office
cases.employee_justification: An exceptional trip for a scheduled meeting with our visiting client, not my usual commute.
cases.reason: Specific exceptional client meeting distinguishes this journey.

cases.invoice_item_description: Cab passenger trip from home to the regular office
cases.employee_justification: An unusual office visit to attend mandatory internal technical training.
cases.reason: Identified exceptional internal training qualifies without a client requirement.

cases.invoice_item_description: Cab passenger trip from home to the regular office
cases.reason: No exceptional purpose is established; absence of detail is not proof of ordinary commuting.

cases.invoice_item_description: Cab passenger trip from home to the regular office
cases.employee_justification: Went to an event with colleagues.
cases.reason: Colleague attendance does not establish a work-related event or exception.

cases.invoice_item_description: Taxi passenger trip to the client's premises
cases.employee_justification: Travel to a client meeting at their premises.
cases.reason: Qualifying journey is not home-to-regular-office; skip the exceptional-commute Noul.

cases.invoice_item_description: Auto-rickshaw trip from home to the regular office
cases.employee_justification: I preferred working at the office today; there was no exceptional business requirement.
cases.reason: Personal preference does not establish a policy exception.

cases.invoice_item_description: Two separately described legs: daily home-to-office commute and office-to-client travel; no single claimed leg identified
cases.employee_justification: I commuted as normal, then took a separate journey to the client.
cases.reason: Mixed independent journeys without a claimed leg violate the one-item precondition; clarify scope before J2 or this Noul.

cases.invoice_item_description: Taxi passenger trip from home to the regular office on a non-working day
cases.employee_justification: Called in exceptionally to restore the office network during a service outage.
cases.reason: Specific operational emergency distinguishes the trip from a regular commute.

cases.invoice_item_description: Claimed cellular voice/data plan INR 699; no entertainment extras or separate subscription charges on invoice
cases.employee_justification: For calls and mobile data on my phone.
cases.reason: Explicit absence of entertainment components; no financial calculation is performed.

cases.invoice_item_description: Claimed cellular plan INR 699 with complimentary Netflix included at no additional charge
cases.employee_justification: For cellular calls and mobile internet.
cases.reason: Streaming exists but is explicitly complimentary, not separately charged.

cases.invoice_item_description: Specific claimed line: cellular voice/data plan INR 699. The same invoice separately lists Netflix add-on INR 199; that is a distinct line, not the claimed cellular service.
cases.employee_justification: Claiming the cellular plan for calls and data.
cases.reason: Separate extra is explicitly identified, but J2 purpose for the underlying claimed service remains supported. Flag the separate component without denying the cellular line or calculating an amount.

cases.invoice_item_description: Claimed mobile plan INR 749 with unspecified entertainment benefits; billing status of benefits not stated
cases.reason: Purpose is clear while extra-charge status remains unresolved; J2 and the invoice-condition question address distinct evidence.

cases.invoice_item_description: Claimed cellular plan INR 699 with an entertainment component; unclear whether its charge is additional
cases.employee_justification: For my phone calls and mobile data.
cases.reason: Missing charging detail must not be called explicit absence based on low Noul.

cases.invoice_item_description: Claimed cellular plan INR 799 with complimentary streaming at no additional charge
cases.reason: Above-cap price is not this semantic condition; Python would handle limits later. Streaming is complimentary.

cases.invoice_item_description: Specific claimed line: cellular plan INR 599. The invoice also has a separately charged entertainment pack INR 150 on a distinct line.
cases.employee_justification: The claimed cellular line is for calls and data.
cases.reason: An extra is separately billed; its identification is not a J2 misclassification or approval of the extra.

cases.invoice_item_description: Entertainment-only Netflix subscription, no cellular plan or service
cases.reason: Known J1 category mismatch and no underlying cellular plan; do not force J2 or an in-addition-to-plan Noul comparison.

cases.invoice_item_description: Claimed prepaid cellular package with cinema benefits; invoice gives no itemization of whether the benefit is free or separately charged
cases.reason: The price structure is unknown despite an adequately explained cellular purpose.
